column7: Four post-commit best-effort storage writes were discarded with a bare `_ =`, which drops an error but not a panic: CreateUserWithAssignments' AddPasswordHistory (gRPC CreateUser reported Internal for a committed user + role grants), ChangePassword's Add/PrunePasswordHistory (a committed password change reported 500 and its PAT/session revocation never ran), CompleteSSO/CompleteSAML's RecordLogin (a live Session minted while the ACS reported 500) and cleanupOrphanedRole's revoke_failed lease write (a panic skipped the operator audit for a live orphaned role). All now run through besteffort.Run. Class guard: internal/besteffortguard no longer lets a blank-discarded write act as the last-write anchor, which is what hid every one of these from it (planted case MustFlagDiscardedWriteAfterWrite). Found by FuzzStorageFaultOperations (CI fuzz shard 2 on #2876, GRPC UserService.CreateUser AddPasswordHistory#1/panic); red on origin/main for all four fuzz tuples.
